config.reply: % Saved, but the policy already on the Earth link is EARTH-OUT.
% Saved: plain RED. The orders ask for DSCP-based (weighted) RED: random-detect dscp-based
% Volt pulls the cable before you hit enter. Check what per-packet does to TCP first.

steps.title: Name the problem
steps.body: Type `enable`. Run `show policy-map interface g0/1`: tail drop only. Then `more flash:link-graph.txt`. `submit PROBLEM=<name of the effect>`.

steps.title: Drop early, at random
steps.body: In `conf t`: `policy-map EARTH-OUT`, `class class-default`, `random-detect dscp-based`. `end`, then `show policy-map interface g0/1`: random drops, mostly scavenger (cs1), and no tail drops.

objectives.label: Saw random drops replace tail drops

steps.title: Spread without reordering
steps.body: Run `show ip cef exact-route 192.168.10.10 198.51.100.10` and `show ip cef exact-route 192.168.30.10 198.51.100.10`: two flows, two different links, chosen by a hash. Rivet wanted per-packet instead. What would that do to TCP? `submit PERPACKET=<one word>`. Then which unit should the Citadel spread? `submit SPREAD=per-flow` or `per-packet`.
